name: M3_PDS016MI_LstDailyCap
description: List daily capacity for a specific work center within a facility. The request returns one record per defined capacity time bucket, including capacity date, start and end time, shift, utilization rate, nominal number of hours, capacity per unit and shift, number of machines, capacity type, alternate capacity, and its unit of measure. Use this read-only operation to review how a work center’s available capacity is distributed during the day and to supply external planning, scheduling, or reporting solutions with detailed capacity information.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility whose work center daily capacity should be listed.

inputParameters.name: PLGR
inputParameters.description: Work center whose daily capacity records should be listed.

inputParameters.name: DATE
inputParameters.description: Calendar date from which to list daily capacity records for the work center.

inputParameters.name: STIM
inputParameters.description: Start time of the capacity interval from which to begin listing daily capacity records.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number for which the facility and work center are defined.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility where the work center daily capacity is defined.

outputParameters.name: PLGR
outputParameters.description: Work center whose daily capacity is listed.

outputParameters.name: DATE
outputParameters.description: Calendar date for this daily capacity record.

outputParameters.name: STIM
outputParameters.description: Start time of the daily capacity interval on this date.

outputParameters.name: SHFC
outputParameters.description: Shift identifier for this daily capacity record.

outputParameters.name: ETIM
outputParameters.description: End time of the daily capacity interval on this date.

outputParameters.name: AVEF
outputParameters.description: Utilization rate expressing net capacity as a percentage of rated capacity for this work center on this date.

outputParameters.name: GHRS
outputParameters.description: Nominal number of work hours available for the work center in this interval.

outputParameters.name: PCAP
outputParameters.description: Capacity type indicating whether capacity is measured in machine hours or man-hours.

outputParameters.name: WCNM
outputParameters.description: Number of machines included in the work center for this daily capacity record.

outputParameters.name: CPTY
outputParameters.description: Rated capacity per unit and shift for the work center used when calculating available capacity and lead times.

outputParameters.name: ACAP
outputParameters.description: Rated alternate capacity per unit and shift for the work center.

outputParameters.name: RCUN
outputParameters.description: Unit of measure used to express the alternate capacity.
